title: Tinkbit Modpack
description: Collection of mods for use on the Tinkbit Minecraft server!
body: A modpack made for use on the Tinkbit minecraft server. contains mostly performance mods like Sodium and Lithium, but Litematica and Flashback are also included. The Tinkbit minecraft server IP, and schematic for the bridge, are also included. For a full list of mods, please check the gallery for a picture.
